annotation.emotional_arc: wonder to peaceful acceptance of an endless journey

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: The surface of the earth or the ground from which water vapor rises to form clouds, conceptualized as a mother's protective lap.
acceptable_visual_variants: Soft mist rising from green hills into the sky
Vapor ascending from a river valley at dawn
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: An illustrator might draw a literal giant woman made of soil holding clouds in her lap, which would look cartoonish and miss the poetic sense of natural origin.
metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Depict mist or vapor gently rising from a lush, warm landscape or valley floor towards the sky, suggesting a natural birth or rising from the ground.

translation_loss.what_was_lost: The translation of 'godi' as 'embrace' loses the specific cultural and physical imagery of a mother's lap, which is central to the Hindi concept of 'godi'.
The rhythmic and continuous aspect of the reduplicated participle 'udte-udte' (flying and flying / while flying) is simplified to a single English participle 'as they flew'.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: The clouds appearing bright, pleasant, or parting to let sunlight through, conceptualized as smiling.
acceptable_visual_variants: Sunlight breaking through soft white clouds
Brightly lit cloud edges against a blue sky
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: Drawing literal cartoon faces with smiles on the clouds, which ruins the naturalistic poetic tone.
metaphor_spans.tenor: Clouds parting or looking bright and pleasant
metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Depict clouds with soft, bright edges illuminated by golden sunlight breaking through, conveying a cheerful and warm atmosphere.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: The clouds raining (crying) and being bright or thundering joyfully (laughing) as they move, representing the changing states of nature or human emotions.
acceptable_visual_variants: A landscape with rain falling in the distance while the foreground is sunlit
A single cloud casting rain on one side and catching bright sunlight on the other
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: Depicting clouds with literal weeping eyes and laughing mouths, which looks childish.

metaphor_mapping.tenor_concept: weather patterns of rain and sunshine
transferred_attributes: alternating states of sadness and joy

metaphor_spans.source_span_translation: At times crying, at times laughing.
metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Show a split or transitioning sky where one side has gentle rain falling (crying) and the other side has bright, sunlit clouds (laughing).

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: Every change in the wind or direction of the clouds brings a new shape, weather pattern, or phase of their journey.
acceptable_visual_variants: Clouds morphing in shape as they drift across different landscapes
A sequence of panels showing a cloud changing form over time
metaphor_spans.literal_meaning: A new story at every turn
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: Depicting literal books or written words floating in the sky at physical road bends.

metaphor_mapping.tenor_concept: atmospheric changes and shifting cloud formations

metaphor_spans.source_span_original: हर मोड़ पे एक नई कहानी
metaphor_spans.source_span_translation: At every turn, a new story
metaphor_spans.source_term: हर मोड़ पे एक नई कहानी
metaphor_spans.tenor: The changing shapes and experiences of clouds as they drift
metaphor_spans.vehicle: A journey with narrative twists and stories
metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Show clouds changing shape dramatically as they pass over different terrains (e.g., shifting from wispy over mountains to dense over plains).

translation_loss.what_was_lost: The feminine noun 'anjaani' (an unknown female person or entity) is translated as a generic abstract noun 'unknown', losing the personified feminine quality of the original Hindi word.

annotation.theme: The eternal, cyclical journey of clouds as a metaphor for life's changing emotions and endless movement

original_poem:
बादलों का सफर था शुरू,  
आसमान के रंग बदल रहे थे,  
धरती की गोदी से निकले थे,  
उड़ते-उड़ते बादल बन रहे थे।

कभी गरजते थे, कभी मुस्काते,  
पानी की बूँदें गिराते थे,  
वो सफर कितना लंबा था,  
कभी रोते, कभी हँसते थे।

हर मोड़ पे एक नई कहानी,  
हर दिशा में एक नई अंजानी,  
सभी बादल अब दूर जा रहे हैं,  
पर उनका सफर कभी खत्म नहीं होता।
translated_poem:
The journey of the clouds had begun,  
The colors of the sky were changing,  
From the earth's embrace they had risen,  
Turning into clouds as they flew.

Sometimes they thundered, sometimes they smiled,  
Dropping drops of rain,  
How long their journey was,  
At times crying, at times laughing.

At every turn, a new story,  
In every direction, a new unknown,  
All the clouds are now moving far away,  
But their journey never ends.
